notes.subject: בן פרת... בן פרת
notes.rationale: Tupela tok i rikwikim wantaim — pasin bilong tok Hibru, na Tok Pisin i holim dispela rikwik.

notes.subject: עלי עין
notes.rationale: 'long pes bilong wara': עין i minai 'ai' o 'hol wara'; KJV rit 'by a well' (באר), JPS 'by a fountain'.

notes.subject: ol pikinini meri
notes.rationale: בנות i tok tok i no gat minai yet — 'olsekem branch bilong diwai' (KJV 'branches') o 'ol dai' (rit bilong Ugarit) i posibol tasol mi holim leta.

translation: Yosep em i pikinini bilong karim planti frut, pikinini bilong karim planti frut long pes bilong wara; ol pikinini meri bilong em i wokabaut antap long banis.
